test_title: PYST 13: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - Reasoning (Held On: 16th Sep 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: Find the odd one out from the given alternatives:
solution:
The logic follows here, 

 
• Right to Equality, Right to Freedom, and Right against Exploitation are Fundamental Rights under the Indian Constitution.
 
• Right to Property is no longer a Fundamental Right (it is now a legal/constitutional right under Article 300A).
 
• Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**
